profile.name: Sushant Chaudhary
profile.title: Aspiring Data Scientist
profile.tagline: CS student building data-driven projects with Python, pandas and machine learning.

projects.title: Nepal Crop Yield Prediction
projects.description: ML project predicting crop yield from 45 years of Nepal rainfall data. Trained Random Forest with 5-fold cross-validation (R²=0.776). Built SQLite pipeline with analytical queries. Detected and removed feature leakage from the year column.

projects.title: Nepal Data Assistant — AI Agent
projects.description: An AI agent that searches the web and does accurate math using tool calling. Built with Groq (GPT-OSS) and Streamlit. Streams responses live, remembers conversation context, and chains tools autonomously.

projects.title: Nepal Rainfall Analysis
projects.description: Explored 45 years of Nepal rainfall data (1981–present) across 84 regions. Found strong monsoon seasonality, ~2.5x regional variation, and no strong long-term trend.

projects.title: CampusCart — Student Marketplace
projects.description: A full-stack student marketplace built with Flask. Uses SQLite for local development and PostgreSQL in production. Deployed on Render with live database support. Features user auth, cart, and seller dashboard.
